summary:
bash: # Set ACLs on /srv/shared

# 1. Group research: rwx (current + default)
setfacl -m g:research:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m g:research:rwx /srv/shared

# 2. User alice: rwx (current + default)
setfacl -m u:alice:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m u:alice:rwx /srv/shared

# 3. User bob: rwx (current + default)
setfacl -m u:bob:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m u:bob:rwx /srv/shared

# 4. Others: no permissions (current + default)
setfacl -m o::--- /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m o::--- /srv/shared

# 5. Set mask to rwx to ensure ACL entries are not restricted
setfacl -m m::rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m m::rwx /srv/shared

echo "ACLs configured"

getfacl /srv/shared/test_inheritance 2>/dev/null
echo "--- Removing test file ---"
rm /srv/shared/test_inheritance
echo "--- Done ---"
